hero.title: Iungo IoT
hero.presentation: The physical layer of the Iungo platform. Assets, people, environments — all of them as real-time data.
hero.description: RFID, BLE, LoRa, NFC, and GPS unified on a single platform — Iungo Asset Cloud. The same infrastructure that tracks 70,000+ assets at one of the largest retailers in Brazil.
